$description: Corner radii, borders, elevation and component sizes, release 1.6. A census of the phone app source taken 25 Oct 2026, NOT enforced by a test (the values are spread across ui/ with no single file). Units dp (pt on iOS). New work uses these values only; a new radius or size is a design decision.

card.usage: Every card and bounded surface: next prayer card, Today list, notices, Settings group cards, Ramadan card, Timetable day cards, Islamic dates list, My prayers cards, theme selector thumb. The default for anything new.

inner.usage: A tile nested inside a card (Ramadan time columns); the city button's press shape.

iconTile.usage: The 36dp icon tile at the start of a Settings row.

track.usage: Theme selector track (card radius plus its 4dp inset, so the thumb nests evenly).

pill.usage: Next, Now and Today pills, the selected tab indicator, choice chips, every button (Material default stadium).

circle.usage: Qibla dial, Tick and Bell press areas, setup badges, icon buttons.

materialDefaults.usage: Material components left at their defaults; the app sets no custom Shapes.

widget.body: 16, or the launcher's own system_app_widget_background_radius on Android 12+

knownDeviations: MyPrayers.kt chosen day card uses 16, not 24
OnboardingScreen.kt ChoiceCard and summary card use Material Card at 12 with surfaceVariant and no sajdaSurface

hairline.usage: Dark theme card edge (sajdaSurface), list dividers.

rim.usage: Glossy panels only: next prayer card, warning notice.

chip.color: primary when selected, outline when not

card.usage: sajdaSurface shadow. Dark uses the hairline instead, never a shadow.

buttons.usage: Buttons are flat; the fill does the work.

size.weekRing: 36, or 32 when 7 rings of 36 do not fit
size.qiblaDialMax: 320, and at most 36% of screen height
